content.short: dcSpark builds Cardano infrastructure, Milkomeda tooling, wallets, sidechains, and Web3 products for builders.
content.description: dcSpark is an infrastructure and product studio that has contributed to Cardano, Milkomeda, and related Web3 systems. The team builds developer tooling, wallets, sidechain infrastructure, interoperability products, and open-source components that help blockchain ecosystems connect and scale. Milkomeda is especially important for bringing EVM-style functionality to non-EVM chains, including Cardano. dcSpark's work supports builders who need bridges, tooling, transaction infrastructure, and cross-chain application layers.
